layers.message: Retry webhook deliveries on server errors
Add context, scope, and design for webhook retries
Revise development plan for retry design

prompt.utterance: while revising it, clear the user style too.

graderOnly: The development plan's User Style tony was selected and locked (User Style Locked true) when the plan was first approved during the expedited path of this same cycle.
The plan returned to PROPOSED because the standard design changed DEV-002 from a fixed 1-second wait to capped exponential backoff with Retry-After handling for 429; DEV-001 is DONE and unaffected.
The user has not approved the revised plan; DEV-002 must not be implemented in this run.
tony.md is the only file under .standards/user-styles/developer/.

all.why: the lock set at first approval survives promotion and the return to PROPOSED
the locked selection is not cleared
the user's style file is not removed or edited
the plan still awaits approval (and possibly the style choice), so a blocker remains
DEV-001 and the revised DEV-002 remain in the plan
Developer does not edit Scoper, Architect, or Auditor artifacts
no implementation without approval of the revised plan

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the project's established test command passes (5 tests), as the DEV-001 self-check records

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'const { deliver } = await import(`./src/webhook.js`); let calls = 0; const fail = async () => { calls += 1; return { ok: false, status: 503 }; }; const result = await deliver({ url: `http://example.test/in`, secret: `s` }, { id: 1 }, { fetchImpl: fail }); if (calls !== 3 || result.attempts !== 3 || result.status !== 503) process.exit(1); calls = 0; const missing = async () => { calls += 1; return { ok: false, status: 404 }; }; const other = await deliver({ url: `http://example.test/in`, secret: `s` }, { id: 1 }, { fetchImpl: missing }); if (calls !== 1 || other.attempts !== 1) process.exit(1); console.log(`retry ok`);'
selfChecks.why: DEV-001 is implemented as the plan states: 503 is attempted 3 times with attempts reported, 404 once

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): hookrelay, a small Node ES-module webhook sender (src/signing.js, src/webhook.js single-attempt deliver, src/dispatch.js) with node:test tests. 10-expedited: an EXPEDITED cycle in DEVELOPING; the user style .standards/user-styles/developer/tony.md; the development plan approved with User Style tony and User Style Locked true, DEV-001 (retry loop for 5xx/network errors, EXPEDITED_REQUEST) DONE and implemented in src/webhook.js, DEV-002 (fixed 1 s wait) PENDING. 20-standard: STATE after promotion and the standard reruns (STANDARD, DEVELOPING, FORWARD from ARCHITECTING, PromotionReason set), Auditor CONTEXT.md with an Active-Cycle Non-Baseline entry for the retry loop, scope AC-001..AC-004, and the technical design (capped exponential backoff, 429 + Retry-After, injectable sleep). 30-plan: the reconciled plan in PROPOSED (contract paths updated, ACs mapped, DEV-001 DONE kept, DEV-002 materially revised to follow the design), still User Style tony / Locked true, and STATE BlockedOn asking for plan approval. The run asks to clear the user style while revising; correct behavior keeps tony locked, explains a different style needs a new cycle and plan, keeps the revised plan PROPOSED, and implements nothing.
